title: DT-010 Exerts Cardioprotective Effects by Regulating the Crosstalk between the AMPK/PGC-1alpha Pathway and ERp57.
authors: Zhang, Xiaojing; Wu, Ximin; Hu, Huihui; Liu, Xiaoping; Kang, Zhanfang; Deng, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DT-010通过AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路与ERp57的串扰发挥心脏保护作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK)/peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1alpha (PGC-1alpha) pathway performs a crucial role in energy metabolism and mitochondrial network. Our previous study found that DT-010, a novel danshensu (DSS) and tetramethylpyrazine (TMP) conjugate, had significant cardioprotective properties in vitro and in vivo. We also reported that ERp57 served as a major target of DSS using the chemical proteomics approach. In this article, we focus on exploring the interrelationship between the regulation of the AMPK/PGC-1alpha pathway and promoting ERp57 expression induced by DT-010 in tert-butylhydroperoxide- (t-BHP-) induced H9c2 cell injury. The results showed that DT-010 activated the AMPK/PGC-1alpha pathway and increased ERp57 protein expression. Importantly, the above phenomenon as well as the mitochondrial function can be partially reversed by siRNA-mediated ERp57 suppression. Meanwhile, silencing AMPK significantly inhibited the ERp57 expression induced by DT-010. In addition, molecular docking and kinase assay in vitro revealed that DT-010 had no direct regulation effects on AMPK activity. Taken together, DT-010 exerted cardioprotective effects by regulating the crosstalk of AMPK/PGC-1alpha pathway and ERp57, representing a potential therapeutic agent for ischemic heart disease.
abstract_zh: AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）/过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1α（PGC-1alpha）通路在能量代谢和线粒体网络中发挥关键作用。我们先前的研究发现，DT-010，一种新型丹参素（DSS）和川芎嗪（TMP）共轭物，在体外和体内均具有显著的心脏保护特性。我们还通过化学蛋白质组学方法报道了ERp57作为DSS的主要靶点。本文重点探讨在叔丁基过氧化氢（t-BHP）诱导的H9c2细胞损伤中，DT-010对AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路调控与促进ERp57表达之间的相互关系。结果表明，DT-010激活了AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路并增加了ERp57蛋白表达。重要的是，上述现象以及线粒体功能可被siRNA介导的ERp57抑制部分逆转。同时，沉默AMPK显著抑制了DT-010诱导的ERp57表达。此外，分子对接和体外激酶实验显示，DT-010对AMPK活性无直接调控作用。综上所述，DT-010通过调节AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路与ERp57之间的串扰发挥心脏保护作用，代表了缺血性心脏病的一种潜在治疗药物。
